title.zh: Interpol Recovers $105M in African Cybercrime Sweep That Shut Illegal Crypto Mines
title.en: Interpol Recovers $105M in African Cybercrime Sweep That Shut Illegal Crypto Mines

current_state.zh: Interpol-coordinated Operation Serengeti III across 21 African countries led to 1,462 arrests, over $105 million recovered, and the shutdown of illegal crypto mining centers in Angola and crypto-linked fraud networks in Nigeria.
current_state.en: Interpol-coordinated Operation Serengeti III across 21 African countries led to 1,462 arrests, over $105 million recovered, and the shutdown of illegal crypto mining centers in Angola and crypto-linked fraud networks in Nigeria.
